title: Finding Kim Kitsuragi

additional: Written in the Style of the Game Disco Elysium

summary:
SHIVERS - Somewhere in Central Jamrock, a teacher opens the door to a frail-looking woman and urges her to take the last empty seat in the room. Beside her sits her own son, barely big enough to fully set his feet on the floor, with his head hung low. His cheek is swollen but his knuckles are scraped and bleeding. He only followed his father's orders to never let anyone talk badly about the people he loves. He doesn't know that the means to an end made it right or wrong.
A few blocks away, a disgraced RCM officer is fighting the wave of nausea and panic creeping up his esophagus. He looks back at two of his coworkers, who he still does not recognize. Anxiety makes his skin crawl, and his mind is trying to tell him that the longer he stays in here, the less time he has left. For what, he does not know. But all that comes to a standstill when the officer in front of him reads his charge aloud.
JEAN VICQUEMARE - “Lieutenant-Double Yefreitor Harrier Du Bois, you are under arrest for the suspected murder and disappearance of Lieutenant Kim Kitsuragi.”
